author: Tikai
body:
I have been temp-banned for 'Combat Logging'...
I would like to note that no enemy team member had hit me and I jumped about 10  blocks from spawn.
I had to go eat, so I dropped my Iron armor and swords down at the monument then I went back and broke the glass bridge I had come then broke the blocks at the bottom, then I jumped off the world and logged off after I had jumped. No-one had hit me yet and so I don't see how that is "Combat Logging"
So I would like to be unbanned.
I was banned by Voba is that can help resolve my unfair ban.

Thanks for the consideration,

ElfyAlpha

replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Hello,

Combat logging is defined as intentionally leaving the match or game to avoid a death. I happened to watch you as you jumped off into the void, and left the game. As this follows the rule of combat logging, you were punished for one day. 

Regards,
Vobaseball12

Combat logging is revolved around Logging off in COMBAT. Since technically I didn't even take damage in the VOID. That wouldn't be in Combat either. I think your missing my point of doing nothing wrong.

replies.author: Jahaj
replies.body:
Hello Elfy,

One reason that we punish for Void Logging is because people do it to maintain their K/D ratio, and it is basically the same thing as Combat Logging, seen as both are leaving your team in anticipation of dying. These are both punishable as can be seen here, and first time offenders are given a 1 day temp-ban.

If you are wondering about why it took a while for anyone to respond, that is because only Seniors and the Mod that punished you can respond to the appeal, and only Seniors can make a final verdict on whether the punishment is denied/appealed. In addition, at the time you made your appeal most of the staff on Avicus were asleep, which did not help speed things up. Finally, I'm sorry that this appeal might take a bit longer that you would like because we currently have more appeals that were made before yours, and they should be responded to first, but hopefully yours should be dealt with soon, so please be patient.

Regards,
Jahaj
